decision: A source-agnostic Request -> Proof spine is the release constitution for PRs #2 through #7. Source input and provider output are untrusted proposal material; only explicit human review, exact customer confirmation, frozen contract policy, and independent ExitSpec verification may advance the chain.
pr_1_statement: PR #1 makes the constitution and its executable characterization boundary inspectable. It does not claim that the complete v0.3 release statement is implemented.

source_model.notes_compatibility: The current browser maps Notes or document to the existing DOCUMENT source boundary until a distinct note vocabulary is introduced by a versioned contract.

authority.source_and_provider: May normalize bounded material and propose source-linked facts; all output remains untrusted proposal material.
authority.internal_human: May review, retain, reject, or correct a proposal and define a criterion with rationale.
authority.customer: May confirm the exact visible agreement version or request changes.
authority.contract_service: May validate lifecycle invariants and freeze only the exactly confirmed contract.
authority.approved_adapter: May execute an approved plan or import evidence and return typed facts, artifacts, and provenance.
authority.exitspec_verifier: May independently validate evidence and calculate the typed acceptance verdict.
authority.deployment: Remains outside ExitSpec; PASS is not production, procurement, spend, traffic, or security authorization.

fail_closed_rules: Malformed, oversized, unredacted, unanchored, conflicting, stale, or unavailable source material does not create an accepted source or silently disappear.
Unknown provider fields, authority-bearing provider output, provider errors, and source-instruction text cannot advance lifecycle state.
Unsupported or ambiguous claims remain visible as clarification-required or unsupported; they are never invented as executable criteria.
A missing, invalid, stale, tampered, insufficient, or producer-only verdict is not PASS.
A request change creates a successor version; it never mutates the prior agreement, decision, freeze, run, or pack.
A producer-generated verdict is evidence input only and is never accepted as ExitSpec's verdict.

matrix.statement: A supported request source creates or attaches to one stable POC identity.
matrix.observable: The source and later agreement/proof records retain the same POC identity, while exact replay is idempotent.
matrix.failure_outcome: Duplicate or conflicting identity fails without a second object or cross-POC write.

matrix.statement: Email, notes, meeting, document, and existing-contract input are bounded, normalized, redacted where applicable, and provenance-bound before candidate projection.
matrix.observable: Each accepted source has a safe receipt, content binding, source identity, and source-linked candidate quotes.
matrix.failure_outcome: Unsafe, malformed, oversized, or unavailable input makes no source write and exposes a bounded next action.

matrix.statement: Assisted authoring returns schema-bound, source-linked proposal material only.
matrix.observable: Provider or local authoring output is locally validated, exactly anchored to safe source content, and remains NEEDS_REVIEW.
matrix.failure_outcome: Unknown fields, authority fields, source mismatches, or provider failures are rejected or reduced to a safe typed error.

matrix.statement: Every candidate is classified as executable, evidence-import, clarification-required, or unsupported.
matrix.observable: No candidate disappears between intake and planning; each classification has a reason and a next action.
matrix.failure_outcome: Ambiguous or unsupported claims remain visible and cannot enter an executable plan.

matrix.statement: Human review is the only proposal-approval boundary.
matrix.observable: Every proposal starts NEEDS_REVIEW and an explicit named decision is required before it is retained for contract definition.
matrix.failure_outcome: Unreviewed, rejected, cross-POC, or stale proposals cannot define a criterion or advance downstream state.

matrix.statement: Each retained executable claim declares measurable scope, operator, threshold, population, evidence method, adapter policy, and provenance.
matrix.observable: A criterion plan is complete enough to choose execution or evidence import, or it remains explicitly unresolved.
matrix.failure_outcome: Missing capability, method, or policy becomes clarification-required or NOT_PROVEN; it is not guessed.

matrix.statement: An agreement contains only reviewed, retained claims and preserves exact provenance for each criterion.
matrix.observable: The customer-visible agreement is derived from approved inputs and identifies its criteria, owners, non-goals, workload, and evidence policy.
matrix.failure_outcome: Unresolved, rejected, cross-POC, or conflicting inputs fail without changing prior agreement truth.

matrix.statement: Customer confirmation applies to one exact visible agreement version and fingerprint.
matrix.observable: Only an affirmative, acknowledged decision bound to the exact contract identity and rendered content can continue the freeze path.
matrix.failure_outcome: Missing acknowledgement, stale version, mismatched fingerprint, expired capability, or conflicting replay is refused.

matrix.statement: A customer change request creates an explicit successor version.
matrix.observable: The successor records its parent version, while the prior agreement, decision, and capability remain immutable historical truth.
matrix.failure_outcome: No proof or freeze action can continue from a requested-change or stale predecessor state.

matrix.statement: Freeze produces an immutable canonical contract only after exact customer confirmation and internal approval.
matrix.observable: The frozen contract has a valid digest and confirmation binding; its nested graph cannot be edited in place.
matrix.failure_outcome: Freeze before confirmation, after mutation, or with a digest mismatch fails closed.

matrix.statement: Execution or evidence import uses a server-owned plan bound to the frozen contract and returns typed facts, artifacts, and provenance.
matrix.observable: An approved adapter is selected from the frozen plan; caller-controlled endpoints, workloads, credentials, counts, or verdicts cannot override it.
matrix.failure_outcome: Unfrozen, unsupported, caller-overridden, or unavailable execution/import is refused or remains BLOCKED/NOT_PROVEN.
matrix.characterized_boundary: The current web composition still has seeded support-agent and bounded performance branches; generic adapter selection is a PR #6 concern.

matrix.statement: ExitSpec independently verifies evidence integrity, provenance, scope, and sufficiency.
matrix.observable: Evidence is checked against the frozen contract, expected workload, metadata, artifacts, and deterministic recalculation before publication.
matrix.failure_outcome: Missing, stale, malformed, tampered, or insufficient evidence cannot produce PASS.

matrix.statement: ExitSpec calculates PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT_PROVEN from verified facts and the frozen criterion.
matrix.observable: The typed verdict is independently reproducible from the criterion, measured facts, and calculation version.
matrix.failure_outcome: Producer verdicts, point estimates without sufficient evidence, and invalid calculations are never trusted as PASS.

matrix.statement: Failed, interrupted, or stale runs cannot retain a prior green result as the current result.
matrix.observable: The current projection points to the verified run state and exposes a reason and next action; historical attempts remain distinct.
matrix.failure_outcome: A failed or invalid replacement cannot inherit PASS from an earlier run.

matrix.statement: An Evidence Pack and human handoff bind to the exact frozen contract and independently verified terminal run.
matrix.observable: The pack exposes verdict, calculation, limitation, next action, contract hash, artifact references, and the non-authorization boundary.
matrix.failure_outcome: No pack is published before verified terminal evidence; PASS never authorizes deployment or another external action.
matrix.authority_boundary: Evidence Pack renderer and human handoff

matrix.statement: The UI presents one current task and one primary action through the same source-agnostic journey with bounded responsive layout and no skipped authority step.
matrix.observable: Dynamic source paths converge on the same workbench, browser tests exercise the release-required path, and desktop/mobile layout checks are explicit.
matrix.failure_outcome: Dead routes, hidden overflow, silent skips, source-specific forks, or missing evidence state block v0.3 readiness.
matrix.characterized_boundary: The standard browser job runs the dynamic new-ID file only; guided/demo and managed evidence browser paths are not all mandatory in the current gate.

preserved_semantics: Existing agreement, source, run, verdict, evidence, and receipt identifiers remain unchanged unless a later PR adds a new explicitly versioned identifier.
PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT_PROVEN, and the presentation-only NOT_RUN state retain their current meanings.
A Wilson lower bound remains a Wilson lower bound; it is not renamed or described as a confidence interval by this contract.
PASS is evidence about the frozen criterion only and never deployment authorization.

gap_ownership.PR #2: Unify email, notes, and meeting intake behind one generic source spine and remove seeded-path dependence.
gap_ownership.PR #3: Complete schema-bound assisted authoring and the source-linked human proposal review path.
gap_ownership.PR #4: Add the capability and evidence-method planner with executable, evidence-import, clarification-required, and unsupported outcomes.
gap_ownership.PR #5: Generalize confirmation, revision, exact-version binding, and immutable freeze lifecycle.
gap_ownership.PR #6: Generalize evidence orchestration, independent verification, verdict calculation, and feedback/next-action projection.
gap_ownership.PR #7: Unify UI routes, make the browser release gate no-skip, prove clean install/distribution, and establish v0.3 readiness.

out_of_scope_for_pr_1: Routing qualification, profile admission, campaign evidence, SLO-attainment semantics, multi-run reducer, and qualification receipts.
Docker or guarded staging, real Zoom transport, live mailbox identity, durable hosted authorization, and production deployment.
New lifecycle behavior, new verdict semantics, source-specific product forks, or deletion/absorption of unrelated files.
